opponent.label: Adora
opponent.from: She-Ra and the Princesses of Power
opponent.description:
Adora is a young hero and wielder of the Sword of Protection. Using its magical powers she's able to transform into the legendary She-Ra, a warrior of legend with incredible magic powers. It's very stressful so she came here for a break.

Hint: If her text is blue when the game starts she will transform into She-Ra later.
